_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for ai-driven. Committed to git so every contributor gets the same tool surface. Secrets live in .env.local (untracked) and are substituted at launch via shell env expansion. See docs/mcp.md.

aws-docs._comment: Read-only AWS documentation / resource search. Useful when triaging DevOps incidents (CDK + Lambda + ECS stack) without opening the AWS console.

atlassian._comment: Jira (and optionally Confluence) read/write. Credentials come from environment. If env vars are unset at startup the server still launches but returns 'not authenticated' on tool calls — set them in .env.local before using.
